name: Struck Drum
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' DRUM: six fixed partials struck once per trigger. Two are ring-modulated by lowpass-filtered noise instead of played straight -- a different mechanism from a resonator excited by noise.

controls.label: Color
controls.description: The noise's cutoff, the six-partial harmonics level, and a two-voice noise crossfade, coupled as the module does.

controls.label: Decay
controls.description: Blends between the module's two decay tables; past about 98% the drum drones and never loses energy.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Scales the six fixed partial ratios together, from unison at 0 through the module's own voicing at noon to double at 1.

controls.label: Decay spread
controls.description: How much faster high partials decay than low: uniform toward 0, the module's own spread at noon, exaggerated toward 1.

outputs.main: The six-partial mix. Tracks the module's own output closely; tests/ab.json carries the measured figures.
outputs.aux: Mono: the two noise-ring-modulated partials alone, without the direct tone or the harmonics sum. Stereo: a second, independently-filtered noise realization for the right channel, sharing the same tonal partials as the left.
